program_name: Rebuilding for Tomorrow - Storm Damage Repair
description: Home repairs addressing hurricane-related damage from Hurricanes Helene/Milton (2024). Excludes land, landscaping, and fencing.
eligibility_criteria: Primary residence in Hillsborough County damaged by Hurricanes Helene/Milton (2024). Single-family homeowners only. Household income up to 120% of Area Median Income (priority to 80% AMI). Property not in regulatory floodway.

description: Full reconstruction or replacement for severely damaged residential structures. For homes damaged by Hurricanes Helene/Milton (2024).
eligibility_criteria: Primary residence in Hillsborough County with damage exceeding $150,000 or 50% of pre-storm property value. Single-family homeowners only. Household income up to 120% of Area Median Income (priority to 80% AMI). Eligible structures: single-family homes, duplexes, triplexes, quadplexes, manufactured homes.

description: Reimbursement for verified, eligible repairs already completed and meeting code compliance. For homes damaged by Hurricanes Helene/Milton (2024).
eligibility_criteria: Primary residence in Hillsborough County. Single-family homeowners only. Repairs must be verified, eligible, and meet code compliance. Minimum requirement: $10,000 in repairs. Household income up to 120% of Area Median Income (priority to 80% AMI).
